payload.title: Slay the Spire 2 is the best-performing deckbuilder of all time, averaging over 1 million daily users since launch
payload.content: Analysts say Slay the Spire 2 is the best-performing deckbuilder ever released, and the competition is not close. The game has been averaging over one million daily active users since its launch, an unprecedented number for the genre.
